guidance: No script owns this violation kind - triage: either identify the right domain and say so, or escalate to human with a render and a one-paragraph explanation.

violations.msg: 5A return choke: GND contact pad A1-B12 (2 of 4 GND contacts, ~2.5A) reaches the B.Cu return pour only through a 0.2mm x 2.7mm F.Cu chain into shell pad 1's barrel (+1 via grazing the pad corner by ~0.05mm). 0.2mm at 2oz = 0.80A capacity at 10C rise; model gives ~133C at 2.5A. Architecture D7's structural substitute ('>=10 vias at J1 GND pads') not implemented; invisible to DRC (netclass-legal) and check_current (GND undeclared). Fix: F.Cu GND spandrel bonding pad to shell pad 1 + 4-5 vias (free strip above pour top edge y<39.7).

scope: fix ONLY these violations; do not touch unrelated nets/regions; re-run the failed gate when done
